The abandoned house lit up the whole street as it burned.
Your neighbor left for vacation and forgot to lock the side door of their house.
Your neighbor's house was engulfed in flames within minutes.
garage

The garage and the pickup inside it burned until there was nothing left but a frame.
Your neighbor's garage is stuffed with old paint cans and oily rags.
The paint cans popped like fireworks as the garage burned to the ground.

The sedan was engulfed in flames and its tires melted into the pavement.
Someone keeps parking their car in front of your driveway.
That car won't be blocking your driveway ever again. It burned down to the rims.

dumpster

barn
